title: Interrupt active work with new instructions
items: Autopilot has no fixed step ceiling and continues until completion or a genuine blocker
Send new instructions while the agent is working; they are queued server-side and injected at the next safe model/tool boundary
An active shell/build/test operation is allowed to finish before the agent incorporates the new instruction
Interrupts survive server restarts through session persistence; no pause/resume UI is exposed

title: Longer coding runs and free-first model routing
items: Shell commands default to 10 minutes and can be given up to 60 minutes; both limits are configurable
Long model streams allow up to 30 minutes without an idle read timeout (configurable)
Kimi remains available for deliberate manual selection, but is excluded from default, fallback and automatic specialist routing
Existing Auto/Hybrid chats that had Kimi as their primary switch to an available non-Kimi model

title: Kimi key rotation
items: Kimi now supports multiple API keys through KIMI_API_KEYS, just like NVIDIA
Requests spread across the least-busy key; rate-limited keys cool down while another key takes over
Each key has its own local RPM window and cooldown status

title: Kimi K3.1 Pro joins as the primary model
items: Kimi K3.1 Pro is selected automatically ahead of Nemotron Ultra when KIMI_API_KEY is configured
Kimi reasoning and tool-call history are preserved across turns
Nemotron Ultra is the automatic fallback when Kimi is unavailable

title: It plays, and remembers what it can do
items: Browser: hold keys, mouse look and drag for games and canvas pages; stays open 20 minutes
Before every reply the system matches your request against its live tool list and puts the right tools in front of it, so it stops saying it can't
Several NVIDIA keys rotate when one is rate-limited
Watchers: "tell me when X changes" — it checks on a schedule and pings you only when it matters
State can live in a free Turso database; a running Capability check resumes after a redeploy
Remembers on its own: files lasting facts you state, and reminds you of dates you mention (switch in Memory)
Connectors: one-tap Notion, Linear, Stripe, GitHub; the agent knows their official URLs
Back-tap / Action Button: new step-by-step recipes, including a voice one that talks back, and a free "ping" test
Settings → Skills → Install from GitHub: pull whole plugins (skills, slash commands, sub-agents, hooks, MCP servers), read them first, tick what you want; hooks arrive switched off
Settings → Etsy: connect your shop with Etsy's official login; the agent researches, drafts and uploads digital listings, and asks before anything goes live
Settings → Lemon Squeezy: sell digital products; the agent researches a niche, builds and tests the product, writes the listing kit and storefront, and watches orders (refunds ask you)

title: Run servers, publish sites, upload anything
items: Live dev server: it can run a Flask/Node app and you use it right in the app (serve)
One-tap publish to GitHub Pages (you approve every time)
File picker fixed: any file type, several at once (iOS greyed out non-images)
Capability check: tick which tasks to run and which to exclude
Several NVIDIA API keys rotate automatically; a rate-limited key sits out and another takes over

title: It can build bigger things, and checks its work
items: Asks you questions: tap-to-answer cards when a request is ambiguous (ask_user)
Verify gate: it can't say done after changing code until a check passed, otherwise it says "Not verified"
Repo map and symbol search to navigate big codebases
Optional self-review: a fresh reviewer checks the diff (Model sheet)
Sense of time: it now sees timestamps in your time zone on messages, answers and tool results
Can add connectors (remote MCP), save skills and schedule routines itself (you approve each)
Won't deny tools it has: a guard sends wrong "I can't" answers back, plus a `capabilities` tool and a new Capability-check task

title: Capability check grows up
items: Choose reasoning effort (Off / Medium / High) and a Hard suite of 12 real tasks
Past runs are saved so you can compare models and effort levels
New Compile C++ task

title: More languages and tools
items: Settings → Toolchain packs: scipy/pandas, cmake/clang and Emscripten, installed only when needed and cached on GitHub
Every command is memory-capped so one runaway script can't kill the server
Previews can run WebAssembly and multi-file pages
Settings → Skills: reusable instructions the agent can save for every chat (you approve them)

title: Self-management, backups and worlds
items: The agent can propose MCP connectors, routines and worlds from chat (you approve each)
Settings → Platform check and Backup & restore
Worlds can look things up on the web, and you can read and mute them
